milestone-6-extraction-deadlines-anonymi.description: Implement automated candidate link discovery and URL extractor for official university admissions and scholarship directory/listing HTML pages, parsing anchors, resolving relative paths against parent base URL, enforcing same-origin or permitted academic subdomain policies, filtering by scholarship/admission keywords, excluding non-html assets, and deduplicating canonical candidate URLs.
acceptance_criteria: extractCandidateLinks(html, baseUrl, options) extracts candidate opportunity links from HTML anchor tags
Resolves relative URLs to absolute URLs against baseUrl using standard URL normalization
Filters candidate links to same host or academic subdomains while excluding third-party links, social media, and tracking URLs
Applies scholarship and admission heuristics matching terms like scholarship, admissions, international, apply, bursary, fellowship, 奖学金, 招生, 留学生 in URL paths and anchor text
Excludes binary assets, documents, and fragments (e.g., .pdf, .zip, .docx, .png, .jpg, #hash, mailto:, javascript:)
Enforces bounded limits (max candidate count, max HTML length) and canonical URL deduplication
Handles malformed HTML safely without throwing unexpected exceptions

milestone-6-extraction-deadlines-anonymi.description: Implement precise deadline semantics, timezone parsing, and rolling admission status evaluation for opportunities, supporting date-only deadlines, precise closing timestamps (with timezone offsets such as China Standard Time UTC+8), rolling admissions, and multiple intake rounds.
acceptance_criteria: parseDeadline(input, options) parses diverse deadline strings and formats into a structured ParsedDeadline object (kind: 'date' | 'timestamp' | 'rolling' | 'rounds' | 'unknown')
For date-only deadlines (YYYY-MM-DD), resolves to end-of-day in China Standard Time (UTC+8 / Asia/Shanghai) by default, or an explicitly supplied timezone
For precise timestamps (YYYY-MM-DD HH:mm with timezone like CST, UTC, GMT+8, etc.), resolves exact ISO UTC instant
Recognizes rolling admissions indicators ('rolling', 'until filled', '滚动录取', '额满为止') with isRolling: true
Supports structured multiple intake rounds (e.g. Round 1, Round 2) and identifies the next upcoming round deadline
evaluateDeadlineStatus(parsed, now) returns boolean isClosed, daysRemaining, isUrgent (<= 7 days), and human-readable status badge key
Rejects invalid formats gracefully with safe fallback semantics
validation: node --import tsx --test tests/deadline-semantics.test.ts && npm run typecheck

milestone-6-extraction-deadlines-anonymi.description: Implement operator-assisted reviewer account anonymization service to enable GDPR/privacy deletion compliance for administrator and reviewer accounts with existing catalogue edits, source creations, or audit trail records without compromising audit history integrity.
acceptance_criteria: anonymizeReviewerContributions(sql, operatorId, targetUserId, reason) safely decouples reviewer personal identity from published audit history
Verifies operator authority (enforces admin privilege for the acting operator)

Reassigns all reviewer contributions (sources.created_by, opportunity_revisions.actor_id, source_collection_policies.actor_id, research_job_actions.actor_id) to a deterministic redacted pseudonym (anonymized-reviewer-<hash>)
Records an immutable administrative audit action in the database documenting the anonymization event with timestamp and justification
After anonymization, unblocks requestAccountDeletion for the targeted user so their account, sessions, and personal profile can be purged
Operates transactionally to prevent partial or corrupted anonymization state
validation: node --import tsx --test tests/operator-anonymization.test.ts && npm run typecheck

milestone-7-discovery-multi-retention::f.description: Implement automated data lifecycle retention sweeper to enforce GDPR and operational storage retention policies (FR09), purging delivery logs older than 90 days, evidence snapshots older than 180 days, and expired ephemeral tokens, operating transactionally with audit logging.
acceptance_criteria: executeRetentionSweep(sql, options) identifies and purges expired records according to configured retention windows (delivery logs > 90d, evidence snapshots > 180d, expired session/auth tokens > 30d)
Executes deletions transactionally (or in bounded batches) to prevent table locks and database degradation
Generates a structured sweep report detailing record counts deleted per table and duration
Preserves referential integrity and avoids breaking active foreign keys
Dry-run mode (dryRun: true) supported to inspect candidates without mutating the database
Verifies operator authority or automated job authentication before execution
validation: node --import tsx --test tests/retention-sweeper.test.ts && npm run typecheck

Generates clear, user-facing bilingual explanations (EN/ZH) for each identified mismatch dimension
Supports partial or incomplete profile inputs gracefully, identifying missing user qualifications as informational guidance rather than fatal mismatches
Computes a match affinity score or percentage to indicate how close a non-matching opportunity is to the user's qualifications
Enforces deterministic evaluation with zero side effects

milestone-8-spending-mismatch-cron::feat.description: Implement hosted background cron runner adapter to coordinate and execute scheduled recurring tasks (digests, deadline reminders, retention sweep) with authorized job keys and execution audit logs.
acceptance_criteria: executeScheduledJobRunner(jobName, context, options) dispatches registered recurring jobs (digest_dispatch, reminder_recheck, retention_sweep) based on schedule criteria and authorized execution keys
Enforces job authorization via secret token/key or operator context, rejecting unauthorized trigger attempts
Records structured execution audit records detailing job name, start/end timestamps, outcome (SUCCESS, PARTIAL, FAILURE), affected entity counts, and execution duration
Implements job lock/overlap prevention semantics to ensure a long-running job instance does not execute concurrently with itself
Provides dry-run execution mode (dryRun: true) to simulate scheduled runs and report planned actions without committing changes
Handles job-level errors gracefully, isolating failures so subsequent scheduled tasks or dependent hooks are not crashed

milestone-8-spending-mismatch-cron::feat.description: Implement monthly operational spending meter, token usage accounting, and spend threshold alerts (70% warning, 90% throttle, 100% hard ceiling against US$30/mo budget).
acceptance_criteria: calculateMonthlySpending(usageRecords, options) aggregates provider token consumption and research/outbound operational costs into USD microdollars for a given billing month (defaulting to current UTC month)
Evaluates spending against configurable monthly budget ceilings (defaulting to PRD D05 US$30.00 / 30,000,000 microdollars)
Computes operational spend threshold alerts: status NORMAL (<70%), WARNING (>=70%), THROTTLE (>=90%), and HARD_STOP (>=100%)
Provides structured throttle directives indicating whether expensive AI extractions or collection jobs should be deferred or blocked
Formats bilingual alert messages (EN/ZH) suitable for administrator notification digests and operations dashboard display
Validates input usage records, handles empty or malformed cost inputs safely without throwing, and ensures deterministic monetary math (integer microdollars)

milestone-9-lineage-cooldown-schedule::f.description: Implement dynamic deadline-aware collection and recheck schedule calculator to compute next collection timestamps based on application deadlines, urgency horizons, and source verification requirements.
acceptance_criteria: calculateNextScheduleTime(opportunity, options) determines the next required verification/collection timestamp based on deadline proximity relative to reference time (defaulting to current UTC)

Applies tiered cadence rules: Urgent horizon (within 48 hours of deadline: hourly recheck), Approaching horizon (within 14 days of deadline: daily recheck at configured UTC hour), Standard horizon (more than 14 days out: weekly recheck), Rolling/unstated deadline (bi-weekly cadence), Past deadline (expired: terminal/no further scheduled runs)
Supports pre-digest and pre-reminder urgent recheck window calculation (e.g. ensure freshness within 6 hours before 7-day or 2-day reminder dispatch)
Evaluates isScheduleDue(nextScheduleTime, referenceTime) returning boolean due status and delay/overdue duration in seconds
Handles edge cases: missing deadline, rolling admission flag, malformed dates, timezone discrepancies, and dates in the past
validation: node --import tsx --test tests/deadline-schedule.test.ts && npm run typecheck

milestone-9-lineage-cooldown-schedule::f.description: Implement host collection lease and cooldown coordinator to prevent crawler flooding, enforce exponential backoff on consecutive host failures (429, 503, network timeouts), evaluate host availability, and manage bounded leases for concurrent collection workers.
acceptance_criteria: evaluateHostAvailability(hostState, options) checks whether an academic host is currently eligible for collection based on last request timestamp, active lease count, and backoff cooldown
Implements exponential backoff cooldown calculation: base delay scaled exponentially with consecutive failures (e.g. 1st fail: 10s, 2nd: 30s, 3rd: 120s, up to max ceiling 1800s / 30m)
Supports explicit Retry-After header overrides when provided by the host response
Manages collection lease grants (acquireHostLease) with bounded TTL (e.g. 60s) to prevent abandoned locks, and releases leases upon completion or failure (releaseHostLease)
Tracks host health metrics: status AVAILABLE, RATE_LIMITED, COOLING_DOWN, MAX_RETRIES_EXCEEDED
Pure in-memory coordinator with thread-safe/idempotent state mutations, handling unknown hosts or malformed hostnames gracefully
validation: node --import tsx --test tests/host-cooldown-coordinator.test.ts && npm run typecheck

milestone-9-lineage-cooldown-schedule::f.description: Implement intake identity reconciliation service to distinguish new recurring scholarship/program intakes (e.g. Fall 2027 vs. Fall 2026), recognize edition equivalence across academic terms, identify ambiguous labels requiring operator review, and generate canonical offering identity keys.
acceptance_criteria: reconcileIntakeIdentity(incoming, existingOfferings, options) evaluates incoming intake title, term/academic year, and target deadline against existing published/historical offerings

Identifies relationship: SAME_EDITION (exact match or alias of current intake), NEW_CYCLE (valid future intake cycle for same program, e.g. Fall 2027 following Fall 2026), PREVIOUS_CYCLE (expired/historical cycle), or AMBIGUOUS (conflicting or unstated term requiring human review)
Parses common term naming variants in English and Chinese (e.g. 'Fall 2026', 'Autumn 2026', '2026秋季', 'Spring 2027', '2027春季', '2026-2027 Academic Year')
Generates normalized canonical intake identifier (e.g. '2026-fall', '2027-spring') and provides a match confidence score
Deterministic evaluation with pure domain logic, handling malformed, empty, or unparseable intake strings safely without throwing
validation: node --import tsx --test tests/intake-reconciler.test.ts && npm run typecheck
